patchSeries.title: R2 bounded WebSocket worker runspace (accept-loop starvation repair)

r2Repair.approach: offload only the long-lived /ws pump to a bounded runspace pool behind a non-blocking SemaphoreSlim; ordinary HTTP stays inline so all script-scope shared state keeps single-threaded semantics
r2Repair.admission: GHRDP_WS_MAX_CLIENTS default 16 clamped 4..64; Wait(0) non-blocking; over-capacity answered 503 and closed
r2Repair.sharedStateSafety: worker receives only the pump dependency surface; no RdpTokens/credential-ledger/cache access; per-connection token validated in the pump; audit serialized on a shared Monitor lock; socket/stream/gate released in finally; reaper + shutdown dispose pool and semaphore
r2Repair.frozenThresholds: scripts/candidate/real-backend.js R2_THRESHOLDS (declared before any run; never adjusted post-failure)
